summary: Frontend-only smoke + interaction testing for the ROUJAUNE landscape tablet dashboard (viewport 1194x834). All 12 required containers render (side-navigation, hero-route, alberto-coach-card, metric-summary-strip, training-plan-card, featured-route-card, calendar-card, dashboard-scroll, progress-card, community-card, wellness-card, achievement-card). All 5 CTA buttons (start-ride-button, view-plan-button, explore-route-button, view-calendar-button, join-ride-button) fire the toast with the expected message. Sidebar nav items (nav-training, nav-workouts) update the active highlight and show a toast with the correct label. Calendar prev/next arrows update the month label (May 2025 -> April 2025 -> June 2025). Day cell tap (day-2025-05-20) works and moves the red selection. Today's-plan rows (today-warmup / today-climb / today-cool) update selection and emit toast ("Warm Up selected", "Threshold Climb selected", "Cool Down selected"). Key content strings verified: ROUJAUNE, Alberto, Build & Climb, 62%, Col du Galibier, 4 / 6, 6h 24m, 287 W, 82%. No runtime/red-screen errors. A handful of React Native web deprecation warnings surfaced (see react_native_issues).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Emitted by shadow.card / shadow.glow usage. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (shadow object) used across ui.tsx, index.tsx, SideNavigation.tsx
Console warning: '"textShadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "textShadow".' Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/HeroRoute.tsx:128-129 (textShadowColor / textShadowRadius on signature)

Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/AlbertoCoachCard.tsx:27 (pointerEvents="none" prop on LinearGradient overlay). Same pattern may exist in Toast in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:32.

Console warning on web: 'Animated: `useNativeDriver` is not supported ... Falling back to JS-based animation.' Consider Platform-gating useNativeDriver (true only on native) or accept the warning on web. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:22,24 and /app/frontend/src/components/ui.tsx (Touchable spring).

action_items: Replace deprecated shadow* style props in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts with boxShadow (RN >=0.76 web).
Replace textShadowColor/textShadowRadius on the Alberto signature in HeroRoute.tsx with the new textShadow shorthand.
Move pointerEvents="none" from JSX prop to style.pointerEvents on the LinearGradient overlay in AlbertoCoachCard.tsx (and any similar overlay).
Optional: gate useNativeDriver with Platform.OS !== 'web' in Toast and Touchable animations to silence the JS-fallback warning on web.
critical_code_review_comments: No backend used (frontend-only spec) — matches requirement.
All interactive elements have testIDs and are correctly wired to onPress handlers.
Dashboard scroll container has testID and works.
Calendar month computation via dayjs and buildGrid is correct; May 2025 starts on Thursday and grid renders as expected.
index.tsx is ~145 lines, other components are small (<210 lines) — no file size concerns.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landscape tablet viewport 1194x834 required. Whole dashboard lives at '/'. Bottom row (progress/community/wellness/achievement) requires scrolling the [data-testid="dashboard-scroll"] ScrollView. Toasts auto-dismiss ~1.9s so wait between toast-emitting actions. All interactions verified against testIDs listed in the review request.
rca_of_issue: No functional bugs found. Only deprecation warnings in the React Native Web console — non-blocking, cosmetic, listed under react_native_issues with exact file references.
